data.narrative:
Seurat Technologies, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $178M+ to date, is valued here against a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public company in the robotics and manufacturing sector.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $303M. Peer-median analysis across three same-stage, same-sector comparables—Hadrian ($1.6B), Agile Robots ($1.0B), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B)—produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $1.6B.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $257M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $651M. The material gap between stage-progression ($303M) and peer-median ($1.0B) reflects uncertainty about Seurat's competitive positioning within the peer cohort. Key sensitivities include capital efficiency relative to Hadrian and other high-valued peers, as well as near-term revenue trajectory relative to the broader robotics and manufacturing cohort. The public comp (277810.KQ) provides limited additional granularity given sector and scale differences typical in cross-market robotics valuations.
